content: Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr ŋukyal a bay
Mpal kàyàtyà Yɛsu u mɔŋ, iköŋ a baar waa kyun'läb.
Le, ŋukyal a bay mwɛy kàyàsin tsütsü kusà a nde, kàbü an'köm, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, kya ngye asàkwen, mpööŋ. »
Yɛsu kàsilà kɔɔ, kun'bä, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mɛɛ an'kwen, pɔŋà! » Taaŋ nsil alan, laa kàpɔŋà nde u bay ande.
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kun'swɛŋ naa: « Twon an'sam ndaa ayi itàkal akà mbuur mwɛy. Wɛɛ, kyen akà ngaŋ anà kapɛ ibɔɔn kàswɛŋ Mɔsɛ, ntɔn kya ikäl imbäl ntɔn ba. »
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr un'syääl a kaptɛn
Umpal kàbilà Yɛsu u Kapɛrnawum, kaptɛn a aŋità mwɛy kàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n,
waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, un'syääl amɛ wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u ndwà, ndür ande ikanii anki, nde wàmuweemà usaay mbɔɔn. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Mɛ, mɛ in'kyer akun'kɔɔr. »
Wɛɛ kaptɛn awun kàfuur naa: « Mwol, mɛ in'kwe anki naa ngye abilà u ndwà amɛ. Wɛɛ ngye, tɛn ndaa mwɛy mpɛl, un'syääl amɛ ukɔɔrà.

Ntɔn mɛ in'we anà amfum bàfan'ler anà mɛ sye in'we anà aŋità in'fàler mɛ. Kya mɛ insàtɛn a aŋità mwɛy naa: "Kyen!", nde laa ukyà nde, kya mɛ insàtɛn a wumwɛy naa: "Yà!", nde sye laa uyà nde, kya mɛ sye insàtɛn a un'syääl amɛ naa: "Kyer abà!", nde sye laa ukyer nde. »
Mpal kàwem Yɛsu ndaa ayin, laa kàbem nde, waa kàtɛn a baar bàyun'labà naa: « Mɛ alakyään ndandaa naa mɛ ŋàtàman anki làkwikilà atub alà akà mbuur mwɛy uboo a Isàlɛl.
Mɛ in'fàlakyään naa baar mbɔɔn bàsàfà mper làfàsɛnà anà làfàkàminà taaŋ, ba bàsàdyà mɛsà mwɛy anà Abàlam, Isak anà Yakɔb uboo a Imwol a du,
wɛɛ, aŋan'kwal a imwol bàsatɔɔm u nsà uboo a làpib: kwo isàkal ilel anà nkwoor a an'din. »
Apan Yɛsu kàtɛn a kaptɛn naa: « Furà ndwà angye, wɛy ya ikäl asànaa lan'lɔɔm làkwikilà angye! » Taaŋ nsil alan un'syääl a kaptɛn waa kàkɔɔrà.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr abɛy
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàkyen ndwà a Petɔlà. Kwo nde kàmɛn ukwà a Petɔlà wun'kaar wàŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n ntɔn nde kàkäl anà làbwey a mpye.
Nde kun'bä u kɔɔ, làbwey a mpye waa làtoo. Apan nde waa kàmbarà, waa kàsɛmà mukun'syääl.
U sisye, baar bun'twäälà baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be mbɔɔn. Umbwo a ndaa ande, nde kàböŋà an'dweelà amà, waa kàkɔɔrà sye abɛy banswà.
Kàkyer nde abà ntɔn ndaa kàtɛn ŋangɔɔm Yɛsay ikwe: « Nde kàwɛl an'too anà an'kyal abi. »
Baar bàkwen mulab Yɛsu
Mpal kàmɛn Yɛsu iköŋ a baar kyàmun'diŋà, nde kàswɛŋ alɔŋki ande musabà sim a ɛwà lumwɛy.
Un'lɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn mwɛy kàsin, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ in'kyer ayalab mper yanswà ayàkyà ngye. »
Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « In'kyɛŋ mye anà an'fu, nɛn sye ye anà an'yaab, wɛɛ Mwan a mbuur ikal atälà un'tswe kyatɛy. »
Umwɛy uboo a alɔŋki ande kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, mpɛ mbwo mɛ in'tàkàdyee taaràmɛ. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kun'fuur naa: « Yan'läb, wɛy akü bàdyee akü aba. »
Yɛsu kan'kwaam un'pöb
Ungö apan, Yɛsu kàbilà u bwaar anà alɔŋki ande.
Kimbürà, un'pöb a ngwal kàyi udu a ɛwà, ibɔ a an'dà byàbilà u bwaar. Apan nde kàkäl aŋàbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Alɔŋki bàsin apà nde, waa bun'wiy anà mutɛn naa: « Mwol, itsü mɔ̈ɔ̈! Bi abà ikwà! »
Nde kafuur naa: « Ntɔn nkye làbà bɛ u bɔɔmà? Bɛ baar a làkwikilà ikikye! » Apan, nde waa kàmbarà, kàŋän un'pöb anà ɛwà. Duu a mbɔɔn waa làbilà.
Ba banswà bàkäl mubem, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Mbuur awà wà nà, waa itàkal in'pöb anà ɛwà byàmukun'weemà? »
Abaal a an'dweelà an'be bɔ̈ɔ̈l

Mpal kàkɔlà Yɛsu u sim lumwɛy, u nsi a baar a Gadarà, baar a an'dweelà an'be bɔ̈ɔ̈l bayàtoo kan'dii, waa bàyàbwey anà nde. Ba bàkäl anà umpɔr mbɔɔn, lalan akà mbuur mwɛy kàkwe anki mulyaŋ u mbwo ayin.
Waa le, ba bàsɛmà musà in'kwɛŋ: « Mwan a Nzam, ndaa nà ngye awe ayà anà bi? Ngye an'yà pà ntɔn mukà itwääl lingyoomà kusà a taaŋ mukwo? »
U kikwɛl, làkäl anà làböl a kölàköl là ngul làkäl muyidyà.
An'dweelà an'be màlɔ̈ɔ̈m akà Yɛsu naa: « Kya ngye asàkwen mukiböŋ, itöm u làböl a ngul lanà. »
Nde kàtɛn a ma naa: « Làkyen. » Ma waa màtoo, waa màkàbilà u ngul. Apan sye, làböl a ngul làkaamà fà iköl a mɔŋ, waa làkàbwà kà ɛwà, waa làminà kan'dà.
Aseey a ngul waa bàtiin, bàkàbila u bul, waa bàkyään yinà yanswà yàlyaŋ anà indiir byàbweel baar bàkäl anà an'dweelà an'be.
Apan bul lanswà waa làtoo mukàman Yɛsu. Utaaŋ bun'mɛn ba, ba bun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa nde ulwomà u nsi aba.
